title: LLM-Based Assistant for Dog Care Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2611.29286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This study investigates whether domain grounding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can enhance the accuracy and reliability of pet care advice generated by large language models (LLMs). We curated a dataset of breed-specific dog care information and used it to develop two systems: a RAG pipeline based on TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, and a fine-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B model adapted using LoRA. Both systems were evaluated on 15 dog care questions. The RAG model achieved a perfect average score of 2.0, outperforming the fine-tuned model (mean = 1.47). Statistical analyses, including Welch's t-test, Mann-Whitney U, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (all p < 0.05), confirmed the significance of the performance gap. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的狗狗护理指导助手
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了通过检索增强生成（RAG）进行领域接地以及使用低秩适应（LoRA）进行参数高效微调，能否提升大语言模型（LLM）生成的宠物护理建议的准确性和可靠性。我们精心构建了一个包含特定品种狗狗护理信息的数据集，并基于该数据集开发了两个系统：一个基于TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0的RAG管道，以及一个使用LoRA适配的微调LLaMA-3.2-1B模型。两个系统在15个狗狗护理问题上进行了评估。RAG模型获得了2.0的满分平均分，优于微调模型（平均分=1.47）。统计分析结果，包括Welch's t检验、Mann-Whitney U检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验（均p < 0.05），证实了该性能差距的统计显著性。我们的研究结果表明，在专业领域（宠物护理）中，基于检索的领域接地比单独进行微调能够产生更准确、更一致且更值得信赖的回答。
tldr: 研究通过对比实验发现，基于RAG检索增强的领域接地方法在提升大语言模型生成狗狗护理建议的准确性方面显著优于LoRA参数高效微调。
en_tdlr: Retrieval-based domain grounding through RAG significantly outperforms LoRA fine-tuning in enhancing the accuracy and reliability of LLM-generated dog care advice.
